chart.scaleNote: Each line is scaled to its own peak. Factor level = benefit of this level in % of the base value ÷ cost of this level in % of the build cost (without build cost, e.g. the core: the upgrade base). Factor total = (base value + all gains up to here) ÷ (build cost + all upgrade costs up to here), each relative to the starting value. 100% = benefit equals cost, higher is better.
values.title: Values of all levels
values.hint: Every value can be changed individually and all values that depend on it are recalculated immediately. Only “Apply” takes the change over; it then shows up in the chart as well. The calculation modes below only fill this table. Total cost changes this level's cost, effect changes this level's gain, the factors change the cost (the benefit stays). Applying a parameter track switches it to “Table”.
values.noBase: This track has no absolute base value.
values.desc.spent: Sum of the costs of all levels up to here.
values.desc.gain: Rise of the value through this level, as a share of the base value or as an absolute value.
values.desc.effect: Effect factor after this level (1 = starting value).
values.desc.single: Benefit of this level in % of the base value ÷ cost in % of the build cost.
values.desc.total: (base value + all gains) ÷ (build cost + all upgrade costs) up to here.
values.desc.benefit: Relative effect gain in % per 1,000 cost.
plan.tableModeNote: Table mode: edit the values directly in the values table above.
